name: Origins Arc
summary: Momo's early life at the Yaoyorozu estate. Quirk manifests at four. Dreams begin at ten — Shinobu's wisteria garden, then Natasha's blood-soaked missions. At twelve the vestiges appear physically in her bedroom. She enrolls in a private academy; social isolation. The shared-soul concept is formally explained.
key_events: First vestige dreams: Shinobu's wisteria garden (Ch 1)
Vestiges manifest visibly in Momo's bedroom (Ch 3)
Shared soul concept explained: 'Three separate lives, one connected soul' (Ch 3)

name: Quirk Apprehension Test Arc
summary: Momo enters U.A. High School. Meets Class 1-A for the first time: Iida, Tokoyami, Sero, Kaminari, Jirou, Ochako, Deku, Shouto. Shinobu notes Shouto reminds her of Tomioka.

name: Battle Trial Arc
summary: Indoor battle training. Momo begins showing restrained vestige-enhanced capabilities for the first time in combat.

name: U.S.J. Arc
summary: League of Villains attacks U.S.J. The class faces real combat for the first time. Momo deliberately holds back her true speed and strength to avoid suspicion from classmates.

name: Sports Festival Arc
summary: Momo wins the First Year tournament, defeating Bakugou in the final using judo-based restraint. Shouto begins using his left side in the semifinals. All Might calls her a future legend. Shouto visits his hospitalised mother.
key_events: Defeats Bakugou with his own momentum — pins him with one foot
All Might: 'I believe you will one day become one of the greatest Heroes of your generation.'
Shouto uses his left side (fire) for the first time (Ch 18)
Momo embraces Shouto post-ceremony; tells him he'll be great 'separate from your father's legacy' (Ch 21)

name: Hero Killer Arc
summary: Internships. Momo co-interns with Tokage Setsuna (Class 1-B). Hero Killer Stain encounter. Ch 23: 'Bizarre! Tokage Setsuna Appears.'
key_events: Competitive banter between Momo and Setsuna throughout

name: Final Exams Arc
summary: End-of-year exams. Momo and Shouto are paired together (canon from manga). 'Wonder Duo; Rising' (Ch 30).
key_events: Momo & Shouto paired (Ch 30: Wonder Duo; Rising)

name: Training Camp Arc
summary: Wild Wild Pussycats. A Test of Courage (Ch 33). 'My Heroes' (Ch 34). Villains attack the camp — Roaring Upheaval (Ch 35).
key_events: Villain attack on camp: Roaring Upheaval (Ch 35)

name: Hideout Raid Arc
summary: All Might vs All For One. The Symbol of Peace falls publicly. The entire Hero society is shaken. 'End of the Beginning, Beginning of the End' (Ch 38).
key_events: All Might defeats All For One (Ch 37)
End of the Symbol of Peace era (Ch 38)

name: Revelations Arc
summary: Moving into U.A. dorms. Emotional aftermath of the Hideout Raid. The class processes the shift in Hero society.

name: Provisional Hero License Exam Arc
summary: Hero License exams. Ultimate Moves development (Ch 40). Do-or-Die survival training (Ch 41). The Test (Ch 42).

name: Shie Hassaikai Arc
summary: The Yakuza arc. Eri's rescue. Momo's first encounter with Kurohana — left hand crushed, nearly killed. Her first real brush with a villain obsessed with her specifically. 'Creati(on)' (Ch 48).
key_events: Momo first meets Kurohana; throne of corpses (Ch 47)
Kurohana crushes Momo's hand; leaves her for dead (Ch 48)
Momo refuses to give her name: 'I'm The Everything Hero: Creati.' (Ch 48)

name: Remedial Course Arc
summary: Win Those Kids' Hearts for Relief (Ch 50). Brief breather arc. Momo processes the Kurohana encounter.

name: School Festival Arc
summary: Gold Tips Imperial tea performance (Ch 52). Momo and Deku vs Gentle Criminal (Ch 53). Festival performance (Ch 54). Light-hearted arc before the storm.
key_events: Let It Flow! School Festival Start!! (Ch 54)

name: Hellish Obsession Arc
summary: Billboard Chart arc. Dabi's Dance — Touya's public unmasking (Ch 57). Hellish Hell (Ch 58). Kurohana's obsession with Momo intensifies and becomes explicit. All Hands on Deck (Ch 59).
key_events: Dabi publicly unmasked as Todoroki Touya: 'Dabi's Dance' (Ch 57)

name: Joint Training Arc
summary: Class 1-A vs Class 1-B. Shinsou joins the Hero Course. 'Set Your Soul (and Heart) Ablaze!!!' (Ch 63). Kacchan vs Yaomomo rematch (Ch 65). New Power, New Bonds, and Old Faces (Ch 66).

name: Endeavor Agency Arc
summary: Work-study under Endeavor. Christmas chapter (Ch 67). Antagonistic Izakaya (Ch 68). One Thing at a Time (Ch 69). The Unforgiven (Ch 70). Shouto processes his family's shadow.

name: World Heroes' Mission Arc
summary: Otheon mission (Ch 72). On the Run (Ch 73). Race Against Time (Ch 74). World Heroes' Mission conclusion (Ch 75). Star and Stripe introduced.

name: Loss Arc
summary: A single devastating chapter. Kurohana orchestrates Dabi burning the Yaoyorozu mansion. Ekaterina dies. Momo's breakdown is broadcast live nationwide. Shouto races to her side. She refuses food and drink for three days. Skips her mother's funeral.
key_events: Dabi-blue fire burns the Yaoyorozu mansion
Momo's breakdown broadcast live — class watches in shock
Shouto races to her; ice-suppresses the flames; holds her
Momo refuses food/drink for 3 days; skips the funeral
Class deduces Kurohana's motive: isolate Momo by taking everything

name: Rogue Heroine Arc
summary: Momo goes AWOL. Friends search for her (Ch 78–79). 'Creati vs U.A. Hero Course' (Ch 80) — she fights her own classmates. The emotional nadir of the story.
key_events: Momo fights her own classmates: Creati vs U.A. Hero Course (Ch 80)

name: Preparation Arc
summary: Solace (Ch 81). Return (Ch 82). Allies (Ch 83). Wind Breathing introduced (Ch 84). Momo rebuilds herself piece by piece. Giyuu training begins.

name: Endless Mansion Arc
summary: The climax. Assassins (Ch 86). Shinobu revealed fully as Insect Hashira (Ch 87). The Lunatic (Ch 88). Shifting Structure (Ch 89). Flashfires (Ch 90). Rage (Ch 91). Life Passing Before One's Eyes (Ch 92). Momo's Demon Slayer Mark activates. She loses her left arm. Meets Ekaterina's echo in her mindscape (Ch 93). Todoroki Family reckoning (Ch 94).
key_events: Shinobu revealed fully as Insect Hashira (Ch 87)
Momo loses her left arm in combat
Ekaterina's soul-echo in Momo's mindscape: 'Stand up. You still have something left to do.' (Ch 93)

name: Onward Arc
summary: Transitional chapter contained within Ch 94. The Hellish Todoroki Family aftermath. Hero Society begins processing the truth about Endeavor.

name: Decompress Arc
summary: Move Forward, Even If Just a Little (Ch 95). Momo visits her mother's grave. Class worries; Katsuki scolds her protectively. Hawks becomes Number One. Lady Nagant pardoned and appointed HPSC President. Structural reforms to Hero Society. Aizawa and Natasha caught laughing together (Ch 97). Momo trains her Demon Slayer Mark. The story ends at U.S.J. — a redo field trip for the one interrupted a year ago.
key_events: Momo visits Ekaterina's grave for the first time (Ch 95)
Sero: 'You absolute dumbass, you can't just disappear like that!' (Ch 95)
Bakugou: 'Next time, check your damn phone.' (Ch 95)
'Todoroki, Do You Have Feelings for Yaomomo?' (Ch 96)
Hawks formally announced as Number One Hero (Ch 97)
Lady Nagant pardoned; appointed HPSC President (Ch 97)
Systemic HPSC corruption exposed; former President arrested (Ch 97)
Aizawa and Natasha caught laughing together (Ch 97)
Momo trains her Mark with Shinobu and Giyuu in extreme heat (Ch 97)
USJ redo field trip — 'For the first time in a long while, she felt like a teenager again.' (Ch 97)
